rationale: The camera and lens stolen on the Barcelona metro on 21 July 2026 is a theft during the covered trip, reported to the police the same day with the report on file, so it is covered under section 5 (Baggage and Personal Effects); the snatch from the person is not an unattended-belongs loss (Claims Manual s.7). The camera with its kit lens counts as one item, and the Electronics Plus add-on on this Premium policy raises its per-item limit to $1,200, so the full $980 claimed is eligible. After the $50 Premium deductible the payout is $930, within the $1,500 benefit maximum (wording section 10).
